name: QuinStreet
outlook:
What QuinStreet says to expect

  • First quarter fiscal 2027: revenueTurning to our outlook, we expect revenue in fiscal Q1 to be between $370 and $380 million, implying 31% growth year-over-year at the midpoint of the range.
  • First quarter fiscal 2027: adjusted EBITDAWe expect adjusted EBITDA to be between $38 and $40 million, implying 90% growth, a 10.4% margin and a 320 basis-point margin expansion year-over-year at the midpoint of the range.
  • Full year fiscal 2027: revenueAs an initial full fiscal year 2027 outlook, we expect revenue of $1.45 billion to $1.55 billion, implying 16% growth year-over-year at the midpoint of the range.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed August 6, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
